name: Lottery Winner Notification
description: Automatically notifies customers who won tickets through FairTix's fair queue system and tracks delivery status. Part of the post-lottery winner communication flow.
trigger: New lottery winner record added to the LotteryWins spreadsheet
coreLogic: When a lottery winner is recorded in the spreadsheet, sends a branded congratulations email with event details, transparent pricing (no hidden fees), and a time-limited checkout link. Updates the spreadsheet with delivery status and timestamp for tracking.
businessContext: FairTix operates a transparent ticketing platform that uses fair queue systems instead of rush-based sales. This workflow bridges the lottery selection process and purchase completion — the critical moment when winners learn they can buy tickets. The 24-hour purchase window and transparent pricing messaging reveal FairTix's value proposition against traditional ticketing platforms with hidden fees.
sideEffects: creates time pressure for purchase completion

impactProposal.reasoning: This is the primary touchpoint that converts lottery winners into paying customers. 36.1% failure rate means 1 in 3 winners never receive their notification, causing direct revenue loss and customer trust erosion. The 24-hour purchase window makes failed notifications particularly costly.

businessBrief: Bridges lottery selection and purchase completion — the moment that determines whether a fair queue winner becomes a paying customer.
timeSavingsEstimate: ~1 min/notification — replaces manual email composition and status tracking. User estimates 1 minute saved per execution. Confidence: data-driven.
revenueImpactEstimate: Direct revenue impact — each failed notification is a potential lost sale at €[TicketPrice] per ticket. With 36.1% failure rate, significant revenue leakage. Confidence: data-driven.
failureImpact: Winners never learn they won tickets. They don't complete purchases within the 24-hour window, causing inventory to be released back to the queue. Lost sales, confused customers who think the system is broken, and potential damage to FairTix's reputation for fairness and transparency.
dataIn: Lottery winner records with customer name, email, event name, and ticket price from the fair queue selection process
dataOut: Winner notification emails with checkout links and updated spreadsheet status tracking for delivery confirmation

technicalEvidence.errorHandling: Error workflow linked (oZy3vc0yli2xdR45) but Gmail node has default retryOnFail: false. Single API failures cause silent notification loss with no user visibility.
technicalEvidence.triggerInterval: Every minute polling on Google Sheets
keyFindings: 36.1% failure rate with 13 failed executions out of 36 total
Workflow is inactive despite being recently updated
Email template contains detailed branding and transparent pricing messaging
24-hour purchase window creates urgency and time sensitivity
Status tracking in spreadsheet suggests this feeds into larger fulfillment process
Hard-coded checkout URL (https://fairtix.demo/checkout) indicates demo environment
